GetAlerts shows 557x HTTP 400 on GET /product/{id} at entry_service=frontend; GetErrorLogs(frontend) returns 557 occurrences of pattern {"error":"product id not specified", "http.req.path":"/product/0PUK6V6EV0"} - the error claims the id was missing while the logged request path carried a valid id (0PUK6V6EV0), i.e. the request arrived complete. Following the failing edge, GetErrorLogs(productcatalogservice) and GetErrorLogs(recommendationservice) both returned 'No error logs found', so the malformed-request trail is at the entry handler, not a callee. The code surface (ListCodeFiles -> handlers.go, productHandler) exposes the defect line: after validating id := mux.Vars(r)["id"], the handler executes id = "" and then its own guard `if id == ""` calls renderHTTPError(errors.New("product id not specified"), 400) - the handler blanks the field it just validated and its own return path rejects a request whose path shows the field was supplied (code_wrong_return, not a missing parameter from the caller). Object layer rules out infra causes: all 11 pods are 2/2 Running with RESTARTS 0 including frontend-76cdc49cd7-w54zf; GetAppYAML(frontend) shows image wangyl2128/frontend-v2:latest pulled successfully, containerPort 8080 with Service port 80 -> targetPort 8080 correct, and env addresses correct (PRODUCT_CATALOG_SERVICE_ADDR=productcatalogservice:3550 etc.); the events surface contains only rollout noise (FailedCreate serviceaccount-not-found immediately followed by SuccessfulCreate, and transient readiness-probe warnings during rolling updates), with no Warning bound to a serving failure.
